@copilot 仔细检查需要完成任务要求的所有开发

> @copilot 仔细检查需要完成任务要求的所有开发

Reviewed all acceptance criteria and made improvements in `324bc12` and `85be0c7`:

1. ✅ `pinned: 'left'` — columns reordered (left-pinned first) + frozenColumns for sticky scroll
2. ✅ `summary: { type: 'sum' }` — useColumnSummary hook + footer rendering (count/sum/avg/min/max)
3. ✅ `link: true` — renders as blue clickable text with `data-testid="link-cell"`, primary field auto-linked
4. ✅ `action: 'edit'` — **improved**: now renders Shadcn `Button` component with formatted action label (e.g. `send_email` → "Send Email") instead of text link
5. ✅ Zod schema updated with `pinned` and `summary` fields
6. ✅ 28 tests (up from 21) — added `data-testid` based assertions, action button click test, multi-word action label, avg summary, combined features test
7. ✅ All 237 plugin-grid tests + 138 type tests pass
